t.zh: 介词短语也可以挂在动词上。
t.en: A prepositional phrase can also hang on the verb.

title.zh: We train the model on one GPU.
title.en: We train the model on one GPU.

body.zh: on one GPU 说明的是训练这件事。
body.en: on one GPU tells about the training.

note.zh: 说明“在哪、怎么做”挂动词。
note.en: Where or how: on the verb.

brief.zh: 标出主干，把修饰成分挂到它修饰的词上。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton and fold the modifier onto the word it modifies.

tasks.sentence: We train the model on one GPU.
